title: SrcInsight TraceReport
description: Response of the SrcInsight trace endpoint: multi-token flow. Tokens are a bag of symbol names (not exact EntryIDs) resolved to anchors; trails ride calls edges between anchors (undirected walkForward, or bidirectional walkBoth when from+to are set). Nodes are every anchor + trail step hydrated to full Function plus their 1-hop neighborhood in the asked kinds. Anchors carry score/mode/rank (same SearchHit as search); ripples map anchor and trail-step IDs to their wash (direct-caller count, caller files, test files within 3 caller hops); no markdown.

tokens.description: Symbol-shaped tokens split from query (plus from/to when directed): deduped case-folded, len>=3, capped at 16.

anchors.description: Per-token vault resolution (exact => prefix => FTS => substring, first non-empty page wins, max 6 per token, 40 total). Empty array = token did not resolve.

trails.description: Call paths joining anchors. Undirected: one deepest trail per seed (maxDepth default 7, cap 25, max 4 trails). Directed (from+to): shortest seed=>sink via bidirectional BFS (maxDepth default 12). Empty when no path connects anchors.

nodes.description: Every anchor + trail step hydrated to Function plus their 1-hop neighborhood in the asked kinds (default all). Sorted by id.

edges.description: Trail calls edges plus the 1-hop neighborhood edges of every anchor/trail node in the asked kinds. Sorted by from/to/kind/siteRange.

loose.description: Unresolvable call/heritage refs owned by a node (FetchLooseEndsByOwner), kept for their scope label. Key is the owner EntryID. Omitted when empty.

imports.description: Import statements per file touching the node set (FetchImportsByFile). Key is the relative file path. Omitted when empty.

ripples.description: Wash per head (anchors + trail steps): exact direct-caller count, caller files, and test files within 3 caller hops. Key is the owner EntryID. Omitted when empty.

ripple.description: One node's wash: exact incoming-calls count, sorted caller files and test files (each capped at 8), exact totals past the caps, and whether a cap cut the walk short.

callers.description: Exact COUNT of incoming calls edges, never capped.

files.description: Sorted unique hop-1 caller files, capped at 8.

tests.description: Sorted unique test files within 3 caller hops, capped at 8.

fileTotal.description: Unique hop-1 caller files the walk saw: exact when the walk completes, partial when truncated. Omitted when zero.

testTotal.description: Unique test files the walk saw: exact when the walk completes, partial when truncated. Omitted when zero.

truncated.description: True when the 150-node walk cap or an 8-file list cap cut the answer short.

trail.description: One call path: steps in call order with the calls edges between them. Each edge carries the call-site line range inside its From node.

unresolvedRef.description: One unresolvable call/heritage owned by a node, kept for its scope label. siteRange is the call-site range inside the owner (0,0 = unknown).

scope.description: Values: 'internal' (project module but unresolved), 'internal:<file>' (resolved in-project, display only), 'external:<module>' (external dependency), 'external:runtime' (language/global builtin), or 'unresolved'.

siteRange.description: Call-site line range inside the owner. Zero value {"start":0,"end":0} means unknown; always emitted on the wire because Go struct-value omitempty never omits it.

importStmt.description: A single import as seen in a source file.

kind.description: 'gopackage' is the synthetic per-file row the Go extractor emits to carry the file's package clause.

alias.description: Alias target for 'as' renames, e.g. 'as v' -> 'v'. Always emitted on the wire ("" when none, no omitempty).

searchHit.description: Scored anchor: ranking signal (score/mode/rank) plus context (signature/doc/vessel). Per-token order is exact-name, then qualified-suffix, then score, then id.

dialect.description: Source language of the indexed file.

tags.description: Entry-level convention marks (NestJS: controller/injectable/module, route:Get/route:Post, resolver, query/mutation/subscription/resolve-field). Omitted when empty.

score.description: Raw FTS5 bm25 for fts hits (negative, smaller = more relevant, weighted name=20 qualified=10 doc=3); 0 for exact/prefix/substring.

rank.description: 0-based position inside the primitive page before union/filter.

functionRef.description: A lightweight edge reference (no signature or body).

id.description: Stable EntryID; empty for unresolved calls.

scope.description: Classifies the callee. Values: 'internal:<file>' (resolves to an indexed project function), 'internal' (unresolved but imported from a project module), 'external:<module>' (external dependency), 'external:runtime' (language/global builtin), or 'unresolved' (cannot tell).

siteRange.description: 1-indexed line range inside the caller where this reference occurs (the call site). Zero value {"start":0,"end":0} means unknown; always emitted on the wire because Go struct-value omitempty never omits it.

cond.description: Branch condition guarding this call site. Omitted when unconditional or unknown.

container.description: Nearest enclosing class/module container, if any.

signature.description: One-line function head (or type declaration head or const declaration); never includes the body.

doc.description: Preceding contiguous comment block, if any.

testTitle.description: Test-case title when an anonymous def is a test()/it() callback. Omitted when empty.

tags.description: Entry-level convention marks (NestJS: controller/injectable/module, route:Get/route:Post, resolver, query/mutation/subscription/resolve-field). Omitted when empty.

extends.description: Type heritage targets for class/interface nodes (edge kind 'extends'). Empty for function nodes.

implements.description: Interfaces implemented by class/abstract-class nodes (edge kind 'implements'). Empty for function nodes.

paramTypes.description: Typed params unwrapped to base type refs (Pick/Omit/Promise etc collapsed to inner type). Edge kind 'param'.

returnTypes.description: Typed returns unwrapped to base type refs. Edge kind 'return'.

uses.description: Const value dependencies unwrapped to identifier refs. Edge kind 'uses'.

container.description: A structural container (file, class, module, namespace or function) a definition lives in.

id.description: Stable container ID. For files: 'file:<relPath>'. For classes: the class node's EntryID.

name.description: Container name, e.g. basename for a file or the class name.

siteRange.description: Call-site line range inside the From node. Zero value {"start":0,"end":0} means unknown; always emitted on the wire because Go struct-value omitempty never omits it.

cond.description: Branch condition guarding the call site (e.g. "msg != nil"). Omitted when unconditional or unknown.

edgesReturned.description: Always emitted on the wire (no omitempty).
